To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) the governance of the company is the responsibility of the board, the shareholders and the managers; 2) the accounting is the main tool for governance and reflects it; 3) there are many strategies of the accounting that aims to improve the governance; 4) there are many relationships between governance and the audit process of accounts; 5) there are many processes of audit and control in Moroccan governance charter.

* The governance of a company is a process that involves a number of stakeholders and that it can be influenced by a number of factors, including the company's accounting policies, the quality of the company's financial statements and the audit process.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the importance of accounting as a tool and as a reflection of the governance of the company.
the role of accounting and auditing as tools of corporate governance.
the importance of accounting as a tool and a reflection of the corporate governance.

the accounting system is a tool and a reflection of the corporate governance.

, in order to improve the governance of a company and ensure a better control of its activities, it is necessary to have a good financial accounting and reporting, which will help in the process of auditing the accounts of the company.
the governance of the enterprise is a process of control and monitoring that ensures the implementation of the strategy and objectives of the company.

the financial statements and the audit of the accounts are the tools of the governance.
the governance of an organization is a set of rules, practices and processes by which a company is directed and controlled.

accounting is a key element in the governance of a firm.
